name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.181.0 — The critic is out: the mocks chain now derives THEME straight off a fully approved WIREFRAMES stage, retiring the fresh-context critic pass and its ledger-pinned question producer end to end — the retired mark, reopen target, ask subcommand and answer route are all refused as unknown inputs now, the critic agent and its two dispatch sites are gone, and an assumption row is confirmed or overridden only by the human-run `ledger set`. A note a person did not type stays on disk but is never listed, grouped, counted or gated on again, and the composer's reason chips are retired in the same stroke — the textarea grows to fill the freed height. 7.180.0 — A mock element that binds a seed record and omits its close tag — HTML lets a table cell or list item close implicitly, and a void element has none at all — no longer swallows the rest of the page as its own text, which had silently switched off the stray-value sweep for everything after it. 7.179.0 — A bound mock's screen now names the record it shows: an element carrying `data-record="<entity>[i].<field>"` must resolve to a real record field, and its visible text must equal the resolved value exactly, catching the ninth retyped copy of a customer's name that the old any-seed-value check could never see. A distinctive seed value shown outside every bound element — one with a space or at least eight characters, occurring in exactly one record across all record files — is refused; every other stray value warns. The rules bind on the same labelled, wire-register-linked mock predicate the invention checks use, warning at journey-drawn and refusing at journey-approved, alongside the unchanged journey-level placeholder check. ADR-0023 records the ruling and narrows ADR-0013's records paragraph to match.
